//: Single declaration of how a typed phone number becomes the canonical E.164 string that identifies an account. Read ONLY by tests, on both sides: functions/test/phone_canonical.test.ts pins canonicalPhone and TRUNK_ZERO_PREFIXES to it, test/shared/phone_normalisation_parity_test.dart pins composeE164 and kTrunkZeroDialCodes. Not read at runtime (firebase.json uploads only functions/). Numbers are fictitious: ARCEP 06 39 98 for France, Ofcom 07700 900 for the United Kingdom. `cases` is what both sides produce from a dial code and a national number as typed; `rejected` is what the server refuses although its input regex accepts it.
